description: National Police Commission - Delegation of powers by the National Police Commission in terms of Article 155J
reasoning: This gazette content deals with the delegation of powers by the National Police Commission to various police officers (Inspector General of Police, Senior Deputy Inspector General, etc.) regarding appointments, promotions, transfers, disciplinary control, and dismissal of police personnel. This falls under judicial/law enforcement matters as it specifically concerns police administration, appointments, and disciplinary procedures within the law enforcement structure.
